name: VSN F-35A/B/C Lightning II
summary: VSN team's free F-35A, F-35B and F-35C for DCS World with FC3-style cockpit.
description:
Free VSN mod adding the F-35A, F-35B and F-35C with custom exterior models and FC3-style (F-15C/Su-27) cockpit; a later build added an EFM. Flyable with the FC3 (F-15C/Su-27-style) cockpit, or as AI without FC3.

VSN's downloads are on pCloud and ask for a password; VSN publishes it on their download index: `VSNROX`.

Requires: Flyable only with Flaming Cliffs 3 installed; otherwise usable as AI.
license: Free, private use only, commercial use prohibited (VSN terms)
